source_clause: PRINFO1.) Choosing anywhere on the line for “What is linked to my Profile”, including the “i" will show a page of general info of what is linked to a Driver Profile (see example above. Remove “Memory Seat” section for all vehicles.

reasoning: 驗證目標：10.2（PRINFO1）—— 按該行（含「i」圖示）開啟 linked-info 頁，且該頁移除「Memory Seat」段。關鍵情境條件：條文之 Remove “Memory Seat” section for all vehicles 為無條件要求，故列為 ER 之一部分而非另條。為什麼這樣切：該頁之文字內容屬 10.3.1、All Profiles 分頁之入口屬 10.3。刻意略過：條文之「see example above」指頁內示意圖，依 R-U51 之口徑（指涉所指之物）不併列 PLP 表。
keywords: What is linked to my Profile

tcs.tc_title: Profile linked info page opens from the info line
tcs.test_item:
Profile linked info page opens from the info line
(Verifies that the linked-information page opens from the info line and omits the Memory Seat section)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile is active and the “Edit Profile” tab is displayed
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the “What is linked to my Profile” line
2. Read the screen and check that the linked info page is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “What is linked to my Profile” line is pressed
2. A page of general info of what is linked to a Driver Profile is displayed and no “Memory Seat” section is shown
tcs.priority_basis: linked-info 頁之開啟（**037 先驗 Low，本判為 P2**）
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
